summary: Every requirement fails for a single reason: the migrated WinUI 3 project does not build. The scaffold placed shell files in 'namespace ActivitySensor' (project name) while ported pages stayed in 'namespace SDKTemplate' and referenced the WinRT type Windows.Devices.Sensors.ActivitySensor unqualified, so the like-named namespace shadows the type (CS0118) with a cascading XAML WMC9999. The UWP golden baseline was also unusable (app hung on its splash), but the migration fails independently on build.
